verdict.rationale: Gumloop agents are built by giving a goal/tools/instructions in natural language and can be told to update instructions or turn a request into a skill, which supports NL-driven creation/editing of agent workflows, but this is agent-instruction editing rather than a full node-graph workflow builder with explicit NL-to-workflow generation UI evidence. missing for 10: explicit documentation of prompting to auto-generate a full multi-step workflow/graph from scratch, independent/hands-on demonstration of NL-based editing succeeding.
